abstract_rule: Unchanged IDEA972; no new label mode or optional compression.

literal_code.rule: For remaining character index j=0..60, write q then signs[j//22] then signs[j%22]. This is an invented example table, not a native decipherment key.

logical_groups.literal: Encode every source token character. No literal group begins qq.
logical_groups.opener: qq followed by the encoded complete lowercase suffix; suffix has at least2source characters.
logical_groups.disambiguation: No literal begins qq because escape high digits are a/o/e. An opener cannot begin qqqq. q and qq alone are not literal character sequences.

continuation.rule: Logical groups longer than12units are split into successive12unit chunks, with a nonempty last chunk of at most12. Every chunk pays a five-unit prefix. Nonfinal chunks have MORE, the last LAST. Short logical groups are never framed. One physical space separates framed chunks like other groups; the reader reassembles before interpreting control or literal content.

layout.rule: Greedy wrap of physical groups into24working-unit cells; no split inside a physical group. A completely blank line separates nonempty source paragraphs. A source paragraph must close its block; ordinary wrapping preserves it. Visible glyph labels stand for the offered working shapes, not added Latin letters.

source_scope: All nonempty normalized source paragraphs over the declared82characters, one space between tokens. No source whitespace normalization or unsupported character deletion. Paragraph order retained.
